releaseStatus: Uncommitted working-tree increment; no install, version bump, commit or push.
feature: Engine-neutral project assembly of 1–32 saved Scene2D members, one selected entry, one Godot project and relocatable project delivery.
counting: Targeted runs overlap the application suite and each other; do not sum totals. Initial failed checkpoints and earlier successful browser checkpoints remain historical evidence.
limitations: Godot executes only the declared startup scene; runtime scene switching, cross-scene state/events and project replay remain future work.
Bevy rejects project plans; existing single-scene Bevy paths remain.
Engine project ZIP requires Godot; standalone executable distribution is not implemented.
Browser local HTTP and native Godot were exercised; installed Tauri, Android and other operating systems were not.
No new Rust/native desktop host changes in this increment; earlier uncommitted audio creation work and its historical evidence are preserved.
